name: Tbilisi & the Caucasus
about: Summer (Jun–Sep) is best for trekking in Svaneti and Kazbegi, when the high mountain routes are open; winter brings real skiing at Gudauri and closes much of the high country.
overview: The literal birthplace of wine — 8,000 years of continuous winemaking — paired with medieval stone towers in the remote Svaneti mountains and Tbilisi's sulfur bathhouses and khinkali culture.
costOverview: Tbilisi is one of the cheapest capital cities in Europe for food and wine — Svaneti's remoteness and a proper guided multi-day trek there are the real expense.
